# Volkswagen of Kamloops

> Volkswagen of Kamloops is a  dealership in Kamloops. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/volkswagen-of-kamloops-mirror/used/): 99 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/volkswagen-of-kamloops-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability

- [Dealership information](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/volkswagen-of-kamloops-mirror/): business identity, contact and hours
